info.name: L'ÉDITION Magazine Backend API (Full Collection)
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection for the **L'ÉDITION Magazine Platform Backend** (.NET 10.0 + SQL Server + Dapper + EF Core).

### Included APIs & Default Base URLs
1. **MagizineAdmin.Api**: `{{adminBaseUrl}}` (`http://localhost:5024` | HTTPS: `https://localhost:7036`)
2. **MagizineAuthor.Api**: `{{authorBaseUrl}}` (`http://localhost:5267` | HTTPS: `https://localhost:7137`)
3. **MagizinePublic.Api**: `{{publicBaseUrl}}` (`http://localhost:5080` | HTTPS: `https://localhost:7080`)

### Author-to-Admin Article Approval Workflow
1. **Author Portal (`/api/author/article/*`)**: Authors create and edit articles in `dbo.Tbl_RequestArticle` (`Status = "Draft"` or `"Submitted"`) with cover & gallery photos (`dbo.Tbl_ArticlePhoto`). Editable and deletable while `Status != "Approved"`.
2. **Admin Review Queue (`/api/admin/requestarticle/*`)**: Admin lists and previews `"Submitted"` requests (`"Draft"` items are private to Authors and excluded from Admin). When Admin approves (`Status = "Approved"`), the backend automatically inserts a `"Published"` article into `dbo.Tbl_Article`, links all gallery photos, and locks the Author's `Tbl_RequestArticle` row.
3. **Public Reader API (`/api/public/article/*`)**: Serves live `"Published"` articles and their linked photo galleries.

item.name: 1. MagizineAdmin.Api (Port 5024)
item.description:
Back-office editorial administration API (`MagizineAdmin.Api`).

Includes full CRUD and status workflows for:
- Admin Authentication & Concurrent Refresh (`/api/admin/auth`)
- Article Categories (`/api/admin/article-category`)
- Authors (`/api/admin/author`)
- Published Articles (`/api/admin/article`)
- Author Article Submissions & Approval Queue (`/api/admin/requestarticle`)

item.name: 3. MagizinePublic.Api (Port 5080)
item.description:
Public Reader API (`MagizinePublic.Api`).

Provides:
- **Public Reader Authentication (`/api/public/auth`)**: Zero-friction self-registration with immediate auto-activation & `HttpOnly` cookies (`reader_access_token` + `reader_refresh_token`), Username/Email login, and 30-second concurrent refresh grace period.
- **Unauthenticated Public Browsing**: `Published` articles (and their linked photo galleries) and active categories.
